image_description: Three disposable lighters arranged in a row against a white background. The left lighter is purple with a teal/blue gradient and a feather design, showing a flame. The middle lighter is silver/chrome with a vibrant yellow, green, and purple feather design, unlit. The right lighter is solid purple, closed. All feature standard disposable lighter geometry with metal wind guards and plastic bodies.

artifact_observations.location: Feather graphics on all three lighters
artifact_observations.reasoning: The feather patterns appear slightly 'painted on' or digitally superimposed with soft edges that don't fully conform to the subtle curvature of the plastic casing, lacking the micro-scratches or molding lines expected on mass-produced plastic.
The reflections on the white surface are somewhat generic and blurry, lacking sharp contact shadows that would firmly ground the objects, giving them a slight 'floating' appearance.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the metal wind guards (holes should be clean and circular)
Realism of the flame on the left lighter (color gradient and shape)
Consistency of lighting across the three objects
Edge sharpness of the printed graphics
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the flame physics on the left lighter. AI often generates flames that look like solid shapes rather than translucent gas. Also, inspect the metal wind guard holes; AI sometimes merges these holes or makes them irregular. Check if the feather designs distort correctly around the corners of the rectangular bodies.
